items.title: #FHSWomenPower
items.body:
With #FHSWomenPower, we are committed to facilitating women in the hospitality industry to access the educational, business and networking opportunities at FHS with complimentary passes.

At FHS Saudi Arabia 2024, under the initiative, attendance of women at the event improved from 18% to 29%.

items.title: Collaboration with Fresh on Table
items.body:
Across FHS events, we collaborate with Fresh on Table and other third parties to ensure food choices at the events are sustainable and ethically sourced.

FHS Saudi Arabia 2024 exclusively featured Melitta Coffee, chosen for its strong commitment to sustainability, aligning with our environmental values.

items.title: Programme Curation
items.body: At FHS, we are continuously working towards having more women representation in our agenda and focusing on a diverse speaker lineup.

items.title: Responsible Collaborations
items.body: We are deeply committed to fostering a sustainable future for the hospitality industry. We collaborate with partners who prioritise sustainability, adhering to strict guidelines and ambitious targets to minimise environmental impact.

items.title: Net Zero Carbon Events Initiative
items.body:
FHS is consistently shaped by its dedication to the “Net Zero Carbon Events” pledge, a joint commitment across the events and meetings industry to achieve the targets laid out in the Paris Climate Accord.

The Bench is pleased to be joining this initiative, as it will be through continued collaborative work throughout the events sector that we will be able to make swift and essential progress towards reducing the overall carbon footprint of events.
